# Ledger export retention (2024)

Status: superseded by policy-2026.md.

The default retention period for ledger exports is 90 days, set by the Finance Operations group on 2024-01-15.

Exports older than the retention period are moved to cold storage and deleted after a review window. Teams may ask for a longer period in writing; requests are reviewed quarterly and recorded in the register.
